The modifications in `src/io.c` optimize the polling mechanism by using a dynamic timeout, which improves responsiveness and prevents blocking indefinitely. The addition in `src/transport.c` ensures that the draining process is properly signaled, allowing the threads to synchronize correctly when draining PCM data. Together, these changes fix the bug introduced in a previous commit that prevented clean exits from the SCO thread when using `snd_pcm_drain()`, thereby enhancing the overall functionality and stability of the audio transport system.
